+    # OPTIMIZATION: Optimize tokens_in_last_block calculation
+    # Original: attn_chunk_size + (seq_lens_np % -attn_chunk_size)

+    # OPTIMIZATION: Compute local_blocks more efficiently using integer division

     batch_indices = np.repeat(
